content: Fixed the reported IChatClient DI crash: ProjectName.Runtime/Program.cs called builder.AddOllamaApiClient("qwen3:8b") without chaining .AddChatClient(), so IChatClient was never registered -- exactly matching the user's stack trace at Program.cs line 14. Also corrected a second bug found while fixing it: the connection name passed was the model tag (qwen3:8b) rather than the AppHost's actual resource name (model-orchestrator), which would have broken the connection-string lookup even after registering IChatClient. Both fixed in one edit: builder.AddOllamaApiClient("model-orchestrator").AddChatClient();. Verified with a clean build (0 errors); did not attempt a full aspire run since that needs Docker/GPU and a model pull. Left the fix uncommitted in Program.cs since that file already carries the user's own in-progress rewrite. Noted but explicitly did not act on: ProjectName.OrchestrationApi is still the default webapi scaffold, not yet the gRPC/orchestration-service the user described wanting it to become -- that is a separate, larger task.

next_seed.summary: Rebuild ProjectName.OrchestrationApi into the actual orchestration/agent-system service the user described (replacing the deleted gRPC Program.Runtime.cs/greet.proto/GreeterService.cs), since it is currently still the unmodified dotnet new webapi scaffold (WeatherForecastController etc.) despite the user treating it as the gRPC project's new home.
